name: restruct/silverstripe-favicons
description: One PNG to every favicon, touch icon and web manifest variant browsers ask for, served at the paths they probe, on the frontend, in the CMS and on the login pages

suggest.silverstripe/cms: Adds the icon tags to frontend pages (ContentController)
suggest.silverstripe/asset-admin: Provides the upload field for allow_upload: true
suggest.restruct/silverstripe-admintweaks: Its SiteConfig.FavIcon and ThemeBrowserColor are used as fallbacks when set
